# Taxi & Van Transfers — Athens & Lavrio

> A network of professional partner drivers serving Athens, Lavrio, Lagonisi and Keratea (Attica, Greece). We operate a large fleet — taxis, luxury vans, minibuses and 50-seat coaches — for transfers of any group size, available 24/7. Specialized in Athens International Airport pickups, port transfers (Lavrio, Piraeus, Rafina) and private sightseeing tours.

## About

- Operating area: Athens, Lavrio, Lagonisi, Keratea, Cape Sounio and the wider Attica region.
- Team: a network of professional, English-speaking partner drivers (not a single-car operator).
- Fleet access: up to 15 taxis & sedans, up to 7 luxury vans, up to 4 minibuses, and 50-seat coaches.
- Availability: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
- Languages: service and website in 14 languages (English, Greek, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Hebrew).
- Rating: 5.0 stars on Google with 240+ reviews (primary profile in Lavrio).
- Booking: primarily via WhatsApp for instant confirmation; also by phone and email.
- Pricing: fixed and upfront, quoted on request via WhatsApp. No hidden fees.

## Services

- Athens International Airport transfers: gate pickup, flight monitoring, skip the taxi queues. Arrival and departure transfers.
- Port transfers: Lavrio port and Olympic Marine (specialized in sailing-crew transfers with vans for extra gear), plus Piraeus and Rafina ports. Ferry-time monitoring.
- Group and minibus transfers: minibuses and coaches up to 50 passengers for large groups and corporate events (pre-booking required).
- Airbnb, villa and hotel transfers: door-to-door, including remote locations in Lagonisi and Keratea.
- Private sightseeing tours: Athens & Acropolis, Cape Sounio, Delphi, Meteora, Argolis (Mycenae, Nafplio, Epidaurus).
